offering_description.value: Develops and sells residential lots, homes and commercial land in northwest Florida, and leases commercial buildings to tenants. Sales go to homebuyers, builders and businesses, using its own land holdings and development teams.

primary_products.value: residential lots and homes; commercial land parcels

customer_segment.value: B2C: homebuyers and retirees buying lots and homes; B2B: commercial tenants, builders and businesses buying land or leasing space

end_markets.value: residential real estate; commercial real estate

revenue_model.value: product sales: sales of residential lots, homes and commercial land; rental or leasing: rent paid by commercial tenants for buildings

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs commercial buildings and land it leases to tenants; other: land developer selling finished lots to homebuyers and builders

geography_served.value: US regional: northwest Florida, including Walton, Bay and surrounding Panhandle counties

specialization.value: related lines: residential and commercial real estate development and leasing that share land and customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: company sales staff selling lots and commercial space; own locations: company sales centers at its developments; agents / brokers: independent real estate brokers selling homes and lots
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: land development, environmental and growth management rules, real estate licensing by Florida regulators

offering_description.value: Operates hotels, resorts, golf courses, beach and club amenities, and restaurants in Florida's Panhandle. Sells lodging, golf, club access and food to vacationers, members and local residents.

primary_services.value: hotel lodging; golf; club membership amenities; spa services

customer_segment.value: B2C: vacationers, resort guests and club members

revenue_model.value: service fees: fees for lodging, golf, spa and club access; product sales: sales of food, beverages and merchandise at resort outlets

value_chain_position.value: service provider: runs resort and hotel guest experiences for vacationers and members

geography_served.value: US regional: Walton County and other northwest Florida Gulf Coast locations

specialization.value: related lines: hotels, golf, clubs and restaurants that share resort guests and sites

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-run hotels, golf courses, clubs and restaurants; online: online booking of rooms, golf tee times and packages

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food service, alcohol and health codes, lodging and building rules

offering_description.value: Manages large timberland holdings in northwest Florida and sells harvested pine timber and pulpwood under contract. Also leases land for recreational hunting. Customers are wood and paper mills and recreational users.

customer_segment.value: B2B: sawmills, paper mills and pulpwood buyers, hunting lease operators

end_markets.value: forest products; paper and wood products; recreation

revenue_model.value: product sales: sales of harvested timber and pulpwood to mills; rental or leasing: recreational hunting leases on company land

value_chain_position.value: raw materials: grows and harvests timber sold to mills for processing

geography_served.value: US regional: northwest and north Florida and southern Georgia timberlands

specialization.value: niche specialist: timberland management and timber sales

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: timber sold directly to mills under supply contracts; other: hunting leases arranged with outfitters and clubs

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: forestry best practices, wetland and environmental permits, state forestry and water rules

notes: Business split and size judgments are based on general knowledge of the company and may have changed.
